# Library loan rules

- Undergraduates: books 21 days, 5 items at a time; DVDs 3 days.
- Postgraduates: books 42 days, 10 items at a time; DVDs 7 days.
- Staff: books 56 days, 15 items at a time; DVDs 14 days.
- Renewals: up to 2 times if nobody has reserved the item; each renewal adds the original loan period.
- Overdue fines: 0.30 per day for books, 1.00 per day for DVDs; capped at 20.00 per item.
- Reference-only items cannot leave the building.

turns.prompt: I'm a postgraduate student. How many days is my loan period for a book?
